# VeilsteelLongsword

`item`

Two-handed longsword of veilsteel. Heavy and slow but capable of cracking enchanted armour. Its anti-magic properties suppress active enchantments on struck targets for several seconds.

> Mid-tier anti-mage weapon; demands Smithing investment to craft and Swordsmanship to use effectively
